device.enterTitle: Enter the code from the Studio
device.enterLead: The desktop Studio shows the code after you press “Sign in to server”.
device.question: Allow “{{name}}” to access your projects over git?
device.codeHint: It must match the code in the Studio.
device.scopeReadHint: Clone and fetch projects where you can see the sources
device.scopeWriteHint: Push changes where you can edit
device.warning: Approve only if you have just pressed “Sign in” in your own Studio. The device gets access to every project where you can see the sources, for 90 days. You can revoke it in Settings → Tokens.

approved.title: Done. Go back to the Studio
approved.body: The Studio gets access in a few seconds. The device token is listed under account Tokens.

denied.title: Sign-in denied
denied.body: The device gets no access. If it was you, start signing in from the Studio again.

expired.title: The code has expired
expired.body: A code is valid for 10 minutes. Start signing in from the Studio again.

invalid.title: Code not found
invalid.body: Check the code in the Studio or start signing in again.

used.title: The code was already used
used.body: This sign-in was already approved or denied.

clone.title: Clone from the server
clone.lead: Open the project in the desktop Studio or any git client. Changes are pushed back here.
clone.desktopSteps: In the desktop Studio: “Clone project” → “HSE Doc Studio server” → sign in to this server and pick the project.
clone.cliAuth: Any user name; the password is a token with git access.
clone.disabled: The administrator turned off git over HTTPS.
clone.loadFailed: Could not load the git address.

source.label: Clone from
source.studioHint: Projects on a Studio server: sign in with a code, no tokens
source.gitHint: GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or your own server by address

servers.title: Studio servers
servers.empty: You have not signed in to any Studio server yet.
servers.loadFailed: Could not load the server list.

login.title: Sign in to a Studio server
login.urlHint: https only; http works for localhost.
login.codeHint: Open the confirmation page on the server and check that the code matches.
login.waiting: Waiting for approval on the website…

result.denied: Sign-in was denied on the website.
result.error: Could not sign in to the server.

projects.title: Projects on the server
projects.empty: The server has no projects available to you.
projects.authFailed: Access to the server expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
projects.loadFailed: Could not load the server projects.
